Troubleshooting

1 Check Tailscale Status
tailscale status

You should see a list of devices. If empty or errored, run:

tailscale up
2 Verify DNS Resolution
dig +short @100.100.100.100 dns.ant.dev

If this fails, Tailscale DNS is not working.
3 Check Chrome Settings
Go to System Settings → Privacy & Security → Local Network and ensure Google Chrome Helper (GPU) is enabled.
4 Secretive Issues?
If using Secretive for SSH keys, try resetting:

pkill -f secretive && security unlock-keychain
5 Full Network Check
tailscale netcheck

Check DNS config:

scutil --dns
Still stuck? Ask in #infra-assist · Full docs
